# Code of Conduct

- Take part here on the understanding that you treat other contributors well.
  - What is expected
    - Treat other contributors with respect, including when you disagree with them.
    - Accept that contributors arrive with different levels of experience.
    - Keep discussion focused on the work.
    - Accept review feedback as comment on the code rather than on you.
  - What is not acceptable
    - Harassment, insults, or personal attacks of any kind.
    - Publishing someone else's private information.
    - Sustained disruption of discussions or reviews.
  - Reporting a problem
    - Raise it with the repository owner through a private channel.
    - The owner keeps your report in confidence.
  - Consequences
    - Maintainers may edit or remove contributions that break these expectations.
    - A repeated or serious breach can get you blocked from the project.
